info.title: Goodfit Enrichment API
info.description: Add companies to your Goodfit dataset by domain, and contacts by LinkedIn URL, work email, or name and company, and check how each request resolved.

apiKey.name: Authorization
apiKey.description: Your Goodfit API key, sent as the bare header value

post.description: Adds the company to your Goodfit dataset asynchronously. A company new to your dataset appears within minutes with its name, domain and LinkedIn URL, and its data points, scores and tags normally follow within minutes; segments arrive with your next daily dataset update. Poll GET /request/{requestId} with the returned id to see how the request resolved and, through dataStatus, when the company is filled in.

email.description: Used only to derive a domain. Personal providers rejected

syncToCRM.description: Write the company to every connected CRM once its data points, scores and tags are filled in, or at once if it already is. Defaults to false

201.description: The request is recorded and queued

400.description: Neither a domain nor an email was given, or neither yields a business domain

post.description: Adds the person to your Goodfit dataset asynchronously. Identify them by linkedInUrl, workEmail, or firstName + lastName + companyDomain or companyName. Poll GET /enrich-contact/request/{requestId} with the returned id. A result offering employments or candidates is settled with POST /enrich-contact/request/{requestId}/resolve, or by resending with selectedCompanyId or selectedCandidateId. An identical request that is still in flight returns its id with a 200 instead.

201.description: The request is recorded and queued

400.description: No LinkedIn URL, work email, or first name + last name + company was given, a field is malformed, selectedCandidateId was not offered for this contact, or an external id names a CRM that is not connected

post.description: Settles a COMPLETE contact enrichment that offered a choice: send selectedCandidateId for MULTIPLE_PEOPLE_FOUND, or selectedCompanyId for MULTIPLE_EMPLOYMENTS_FOUND. It enriches the one picked as a new request, with the original identity and options. Poll GET /enrich-contact/request/{requestId} with the returned id.

selectedCandidateId.description: The candidateId picked from a MULTIPLE_PEOPLE_FOUND result

selectedCompanyId.description: The companyId picked from a MULTIPLE_EMPLOYMENTS_FOUND result

201.description: The person picked is recorded and queued

400.description: Not exactly one of selectedCandidateId and selectedCompanyId was sent, the id is not one this request offered, or the person picked has left the company
